events.label: founding
events.text: Newspaper established as a volunteer cooperative in Greenbelt, Maryland.

evidence.quote: was established in 1937 as a volunteer cooperative

events.text: Renamed from Greenbelt Cooperator to Greenbelt News Review.
Elaine Skolnik began working at the paper.

evidence.quote: who began working at the paper in 1954
Other female staffers include Virginia Beauchamp

events.text: Reporter Dorothy Sucher's article quoted citizens calling Bresler's actions blackmail.

evidence.quote: In 1965 , an article by reporter Dorothy Sucher in the News Review published two quotations

events.label: lawsuit
events.text: Charles S. Bresler filed libel suit against the paper.
Mary Granofsky began term as editor.

events.label: court ruling
events.text: Maryland Court of Appeals upheld Bresler's libel judgment against the paper.

evidence.quote: which was upheld by the Maryland Court of Appeals in 1969

events.label: court ruling
events.text: US Supreme Court unanimously ruled for the paper, overturning the lower judgments.

evidence.quote: In 1970 , the Supreme Court of the United States ruled unanimously in favor of the News Review

events.text: Mary Granofsky's term as editor ended.
